title: Philippines, EU Reach Substantial Agreement on Free-Trade Deal
summary: The Philippines and EU reached substantial political agreement on a free-trade pact that would liberalise more than 94% of tariff lines covering over 97% of bilateral trade, while technical work and formal procedures remain before it can take effect.
verificationNotes: European Commission primary release confirms the substantial political agreement and principal terms.
GMA News independently reports the Philippine-EU joint statement.
The report distinguishes substantial agreement from final legal completion, signature, ratification and entry into force.
